Idéale pour le champagne, les cocktails pétillants ou les sorbets express, elle transforme chaque instant en fête. Vendue par lot de 6, elle est parfaite pour recevoir en beauté.

Son cristallin au son pur et clair, comparable à celui du cristal, offre une transparence exceptionnelle qui met en valeur la robe et les bulles de vos meilleures cuvées. Le buvant finement taillé, sans bourrelet, garantit un contact direct et délicat avec les lèvres pour une dégustation raffinée.
Pensée pour la vie quotidienne autant que pour les grandes occasions, la coupe Disco 21 cl résiste à plusieurs centaines de lavages en lave-vaisselle tout en conservant son éclat. Sa base stable assure un équilibre parfait sur la table, pour trinquer en toute confiance.
Que vous dressiez une table de mariage, un dîner entre amis ou une réception élégante, la coupe Disco s'impose avec naturel et caractère.

Chef&Sommelier Open Up Wine Glass: Discovering Wines from Around the World
     " It doesn't matter what the container is ," goes the popular saying. And yet, when it comes to wine, nothing could be further from the truth! While it's certainly possible to drink wine from any glass, a suitable wine glass will allow you to truly appreciate it and reveal its full potential.
 And when it comes to red wines , and particularly wines from the so-called “new world” (Australia, Chile, California…), the Open Up glasses from Chef&Sommelier prove to be particularly suitable.
     Their shape has been specially designed to create a "decanter" effect, allowing the wine to oxygenate and aerate, thus accelerating the release of its aromas. Indeed, red wines are richer in tannins, which can make them slightly astringent; while New World wines are generally more full-bodied than their counterparts from so-called traditional vineyards. Aerating these wines is therefore essential to soften them and allow their aromas to develop and become perceptible.
 In addition, the rim of the glass is wide enough to allow you to smell the wine by bringing it to your mouth and drinking it, but nevertheless slightly narrowed to allow for a better concentration of aromas.
       The pleasure of sight is not forgotten either: thanks to its composition in Krysta (the exclusive lead-free crystal of the Arc Group), the Open Up wine glasses have a very high transparency allowing you to fully appreciate their contents, without tint or distortion of colors; while the typical sound of crystal will accompany your tasting sessions.
 Available in different capacities, ranging from 32 to 55 cl, Open Up wine glasses will be suitable for both an aperitif and a formal meal.
